Definition
[the exponential map and its integral-curve property]

Source: petersen:page-0155, petersen:page-0156 ↗ def:pet-ch4-left-invariant-metric-lie

For $X\in \mathfrak g$, $\exp (tX)$ denotes the integral curve of $X$ through $e\in G$; on a matrix group the matrix exponential $e^{tX}$ is this integral curve, and the flow of $X$ is $F^t(x)=x\exp (tX)=L_x(\exp (tX))=R_{\exp (tX)}(x)$.
